1 2 3 4 Observation 5 6 Bench paper Instrument paper Review sheet 5 / Observation What the bench supports Forty engineering samples were assembled. Six were tested on the bench. None went to customers. Two years is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest run was 72 hours. One preliminary emissions check passed. Full qualification is unfinished. The 72-hour run does not validate the two-year projection.
